site_proofs.values: The one interpolation the scanner does not prove is recipientSub: const recipientSub = b.recipientSub.toLowerCase(), a const never reassigned. b is create()'s request body (CriticalResultController.create @Body() b: any). Before that line create() refuses with 400 unless exactKeys(b, CREATE_KEYS) and uuidValue(b.recipientSub) (/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i) hold, and refuses recipientSub === c.sub; so the value is a 36-character lowercase UUID string, bound by Prisma as one parameter (a tagged $queryRaw template: no fragment, no Prisma.sql/raw helper, no cast). uid (a studyUidValue-checked string parameter) and c.sub (Caller.sub) are scanner-proven values.
site_proofs.dependencies: Caller path unchanged B->S: CriticalResultController.create(uid, req, body) -> CriticalResultService.create -> the this.run(c, subjects, tx => ...) callback. S7-U1c changed around the call, without touching its values: the pre-read owned() became scope() (senderScope over StudyState institutionId/teleInstitutionId), visibleStudy() returns the sender-scope institution after the locked StudyState read, the recipient subject and eligibility take that institution, and an applied-receipt replay also requires senderSees on the replayed record (a Prisma delegate read, not a raw call). None of these assigns recipientSub, b, uid or c.sub, and no helper passes a value into this statement.

site_proofs.sql: One read-only SELECT of the sent list page: cr.* with rb.id, s.ov, s.rs, s.preDoc, s.preReviewer, r.version and hv.action FROM "CriticalResult" cr JOIN "StudyState" s (s.uid = cr.studyUid AND s.institutionId = cr.institutionId, the current owner is the record institution) LEFT JOIN "Report" r (uid and version only) LEFT JOIN "ReportVersion" hv (the head row) LEFT JOIN "CriticalResult" rb (the replacement), ORDER BY (createdAt, id) DESC LIMIT 51, inside list()'s RepeatableRead transaction. It names no AuditLog and writes nothing. Changed B->S: the WHERE's first line cr.institutionId=${c.institution} AND cr.senderSub=${c.sub} became cr.senderSub=${c.sub} AND cr.senderInstitutionId=${c.institution} AND (cr.institutionId=${c.institution} OR s.teleInstitutionId=${c.institution}): the S7-U1c sender visibility (record-time sender institution, and the record institution is the caller's or the study's channel is the caller's now). The restricted-scope, state-filter and cursor predicates, the joins, the order and the limit are unchanged.
site_proofs.values: The interpolation the scanner does not prove is stateValue, twice, both in (${stateValue}::text='all' OR cr.state::text=${stateValue}::text): const stateValue = filter === 'pending' ? 'created' : filter; const filter = query.state ?? 'all'; const query = isObject(q) ? q : {}, where q is CriticalResultController.list @Query() q: any. list() refuses with 400 any query key other than view/state/cursor, any non-string value, and any filter not in CRITICAL_RESULT_STATE_FILTERS (frozen ['pending','acknowledged','cancelled','superseded','all']); so stateValue is one of 'created', 'acknowledged', 'cancelled', 'superseded', 'all', bound as a parameter (::text casts the bound value, it is not a fragment). S7-U1c adds no new kind of value: c.institution now appears three times (twice more than at B) and c.sub once, Caller string fields already interpolated at B and proven by the scanner. restricted (a boolean), scope (a spread array of UIDs, ::text[]), before and beforeId (decodeCursor-validated ISO time and UUID, or constants) are proven as at B.
